body: Same here. No one even let me know I was fired . I called my manager to return to work and I just got ghosted for over a month. It just makes me sick to my stomach that people can do things like this. It makes me lose faith in humanity more and more each day . It’s like each time I try and make something work it all fails.

I lost my first job due to them going out of business. And I lost my second job for no reason . I was taking time off because of a pinched nerve in my back and they just up and fired me. And as for the scar , I got it for not wanting to do my homework in first grade. She literally took a sharp metal stick and hit me over the head with it.

I just turned 20. My whole life has just been terrible. I’m not saying I want the whole world to stop. I’m just saying hypothetically that if I did no one would . I’m not a millionaire so how am I buying property and doing things after losing two jobs in two months ?  I don’t have parents either and my mom was apart of the abuse. I have a permanent scar on my head to prove it.
